items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk. Thank you very much, really. Thank you.

ctx.x: Well it’s been serious fun talking with you today, I want to tell you. It’s been really a great conversation and I appreciate it. And I hope you don’t get too panicked with your upcoming project. So thanks for your time today.
Thank you, Monk. Thank you very much, really. Thank you. Thanks. ©Fillius Jazz Archive -26-
